column1: # The syntax layers' messages: every ID the pinned qkparser module ships through its msg() surface,
# plus this repository's own parser diagnostics.
#   id     dotted <domain>.<snake_case>, stable forever, never renumbered, never recycled
#   owner  "import" when the pinned qkparser module owns the ID, "local" when this repository does
#   ctx    where the message is raised, for the translator
#   note   what it means, for the translator
#   src    what the owning module currently ships as this ID's text, verbatim. For an imported ID the
#          generator checks this against the module at the version go.mod pins and fails the build when
#          it drifts — that is how a new or rephrased message in the syntax layer reaches this
#          repository's build instead of a user's terminal. For a local ID it repeats the source value.
#   en     this repository's English rendering — the value a reader who asked for English gets
# `src` is the module's text today, which for a message still awaiting migration is Chinese; `en` is
# the English translation the catalog already carries. They converge as the migration proceeds, and the
# design keeps both columns rather than assuming they are equal (docs/i18n-design.md §6.1).
# One row per message, one column per shipped language: a language that is not shipped has no column,
# so a message that is missing a translation cannot be written down at all.
